values.note: Individual sites $40 a night (group and horse sites $80). An America the Beautiful pass, the $45 Assateague annual pass or the $25 seven-day vehicle entrance fee is required on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/asis/planyourvisit/marylandcamping.htm ('Individual sites are $40 per night. Group and Horse Camp sites are $80 per night.') + https://www.nps.gov/asis/planyourvisit/fees.htm ('Vehicle: $25.00 - 7 Days'; 'Vehicle: $45.00 - Park Annual Pass') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232507 (notice: 'An Interagency (America the Beautiful) Pass, Assateague Annual Pass, or $25 entrance fee is required to enter the park in addition to camping fees') + rates table (STANDARD NONELECTRIC $40, 2026 seasons), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations required March 15 - November 15, six months ahead ('nearly all reservations for weekends are filled the first day that they become available'). November 16 - March 14 the Oceanside drive-in sites (Loop 2) are first-come, first-served; Bayside drive-in sites are reservation-only year-round. Check in at the Ranger Station; late arrivals check in before 10 a.m. next morning. 14 consecutive nights at most, 28 nights a year.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/asis/planyourvisit/marylandcamping.htm ('Reservations are required from March 15 through November 15. Campsite reservations are available six months in advance'; 'November 16 through March 14, Oceanside Drive-In campsites are first-come first-served'; 'Bayside Drive-in campsites are by reservation only') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232507 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 28 days each year; Check-in notice), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/asis/planyourvisit/marylandcamping.htm ('Oceanside Drive-in: Tents, trailers and recreational vehicles (no hookups)'; 'Bayside Drive-in: Tents, trailers and recreational vehicles (no hookups)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Chemical/vault toilets; cold-water showers mid-March to mid-November only, for rinsing off sand. Campground water runs when temperatures are above freezing, year-round at the dump stations.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/asis/planyourvisit/marylandcamping.htm ('Camping facilities include chemical toilets, seasonal cold water showers (mid-March through mid-November) and drinking water.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232507 ('Amenities include vault toilets, drinking water, and unheated showers (March 15 - November 15 only) ... Water in the campground is available when temperatures are above freezing, and year round at the dump stations.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 83 drive-in standard sites (Oceanside Loops 1-2, Bayside Loops A-C) take tents, trailers and RVs; besides them 63 Oceanside walk-in and 6 tent-only sites, 5 group tent sites and 2 horse sites. 21 drive-in sites are pull-throughs; listed vehicle lengths run 32 to 66 ft. Generators are prohibited in Bayside Loop B.

sites.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for facility 232507 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20: site types, Driveway Entry, Max Vehicle Length) + https://www.nps.gov/asis/planyourvisit/marylandcamping.htm ('A Drive-In "Generator-Free Zone" is located in Bayside B Loop'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Open year-round. Oceanside Loop 1 and the walk-in and group sites close November 16 - March 14; Oceanside Loop 2 is first-come, first-served then; Bayside is reservable year-round; the horse camp runs October 16 - April 14.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232507 ('The campground is open year-round.') + https://www.nps.gov/asis/planyourvisit/marylandcamping.htm ('Loop 1 sites are closed from November 16 -through March 14. Loop 2 sites are available on a First Come, First Served basis from November 16 through March 14.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'There is a 50% discount for campers with Golden Age, Interagency Senior, Golden Access or Interagency Access passports. The discount can be applied only to the site the passholder will personally occupy.'

summary: Confirmed on NPS's Maryland camping and fees pages plus recreation.gov: $40 individual sites with the $25 7-day entrance fee on top, reservations 6 months ahead required Mar 15 - Nov 15 (Oceanside Loop 2 FCFS in winter), 14-night max; no hookups; vault/chemical toilets, seasonal cold showers, drinking water, dump; 83 drive-in RV sites (21 pull-through, lengths to 66 ft); open year-round; 50% Senior/Access discount. Hookups electric 0 now manual. No rec.gov minimum stay. Note kept (AWH's dune remark).
